test_title: PYST 7: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Each of the following triples follows a specific logic and is related to the next one. Choose the triple that follows the same logic from the given options.

SKIP - KSPI - PIKS

MEND - EMDN - DNEM
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b68253ae0cfa7e72d28042cf2031b3ee9f2ccdc5d18a45f52d858f258edaf0fc.png] 

The logic followed here is:

SKIP - KSPI - PIKS →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d9f430541734187e6220b807b31a5e4257d77abe2ff0c74742439b66e587e55.png] 

MEND - EMDN - DNEM →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6179b2450f7392032043d8c7d4ed6760b47e6161d248d86ff1b2abf383e198f3.png] 

Similarly, 

KITE - IKET - ETIK →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/094e180b83d806e6324c0012ec536ba7ddb923e03972d4020eb346333ec70dd1.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
